name: Hold to the starting cells
sentence: How firmly a cell keeps its starting outline. Low: proseg moves it to fit the RNA. High: it stays, and counts a neighbour's RNA caught inside.
info: Made-up cells, started from cells only (started with nuclei, it acts on the nuclei): this cell's starting outline reaches 5 µm into its neighbour, over a strip of its RNA. Other settings at proseg's defaults. Each panel: the middle of 27 copies run in proseg 3.2.0. On real 500 µm squares, 0.13 instead of 0.5 gave 4 to 19 % fewer pink dots.
statTip: Pink dots in this panel: a neighbour's RNA this cell's count keeps. At 0.13 they rise again after iteration 200, when proseg's finer squares each keep the full strength.
